items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: Last time I saw him, I was playing with Paul Wyman's big band.

ctx.x: I think he played bassoon for Toscanini. He must have been fair, at least. Yeah.
But his career was interesting because he left New Orleans and went on up. Last time I saw him, I was playing with Paul Wyman's big band.
